title: RCSI journal catalogue (W2.1/D05)
description: One record per platform journal. Exclusions are records with verdict "exclude", never omissions: a journal absent from the file has never been looked at.

slug.description: URL path component on the platform; the profile id. Not the ISSN (slug 0869-5873 carries citation_issn 3034-5200).

journal_name.description: Journal name as shown in the platform catalogue index.

repository_name.description: OAI Identify repositoryName; empty when Identify failed for this slug.

scope_text_excerpt.description: Aims & Scope paragraph from /about/editorialPolicies#focusAndScope; empty when the journal exposes none.

evidence_other.description: Crawl anomalies (failed Identify, missing scope page) backing an uncertain verdict.
